description: This file defines the ICacheDataAdapter interface, which provides methods for transforming cached messages into batch containers and retrieving sequence tokens, used in the Orleans streaming infrastructure for custom data transformations.

classes.name: ICacheDataAdapter
classes.description: Interface for adapting cached data to different formats in Orleans streaming.

methods.name: GetBatchContainer
methods.description: Converts a cached message to a batch container for delivery.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stream sequence token from a cached message.
